from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=base/'task-3e6d42fd.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for tile_r in range(3):\n        for row in range(h):\n            src_r = h - 1 - row if tile_r != 1 else row\n            out_row = []\n            for tile_c in range(3):\n                for col in range(w):\n                    src_c = w - 1 - col if tile_c != 1 else col\n                    out_row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])\n            out.append(out_row)\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demos=[([[7,6,7],[2,7,6],[1,2,7]],[[7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],[6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2],[7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7],[7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7],[6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2],[7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],[7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],[6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2],[7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7]]),([[6,1,7],[1,6,7],[4,7,4]],[[4,7,4,4,7,4,4,7,4],[7,6,1,1,6,7,7,6,1],[7,1,6,6,1,7,7,1,6],[7,1,6,6,1,7,7,1,6],[7,6,1,1,6,7,7,6,1],[4,7,4,4,7,4,4,7,4],[4,7,4,4,7,4,4,7,4],[7,6,1,1,6,7,7,6,1],[7,1,6,6,1,7,7,1,6]])]
print([mod.transform(x)==y for x,y in demos])
test=[[8,8,6],[6,3,6],[6,8,8]]
answer=mod.transform(test)
print(answer)
